title: Search fails once the holder has a booking
blocker: The search handles the portal generic error and provides its management link. The official authenticated Mis citas pages for three authorized personal identities rendered their Citas pasadas panel without an upcoming appointment panel or modification controls. A booked-holder search response remains unavailable.
unblock: Use the official Mis citas read to identify an independently booked upcoming appointment, then capture the pure availability search response for that same holder.
notes: `aeat cita` for the same NIF throws "did not return a valid offer page"; a
manual replay of the `procedimiento` step answers "Se ha producido un
error interno en el Sistema". Next: capture the portal's
existing-appointment page and report it (with its `gestioncita` link)

2026-11-27: Read the official ADN1-JDIT Mis citas entry with three authorized personal certificates. Each HTTP 200 response identified its expected holder. Every page showed the past panel and lacked an upcoming panel or actions to cancel or change a booking. This did not yield an eligible booked-holder example. Reference: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/ayuda/consultas-informaticas/otros-servicios-ayuda-tecnica/citas.html.
